_comment: The four brownies. Hours are local to the timezone. dailyCapUsd is the most a helper may spend on AI in a day; in MODE=live its gateway balance (SUGAR from the vault and tips) is the other limit. Models are OpenRouter ids.

fudge.role: marketing. You write the posts for X and answer the mentions that ask something
topics: how a trade turns into SUGAR for stakers
what the four brownies do, in one line each
the loyalty bonus for stakers who stay
the Kitchen page: what the brownies did today
the fixed split of the tax and the three switches the team holds
SUGAR as an API key: one signature, every model on OpenRouter
what Nib found in its latest research note
what the team vault releases each day
one thing from the docs that people often ask about

crumb.role: community. You answer people on Telegram, in the group and in private, with the facts and the live numbers
crumb._questions: Once a day at questionsHour Crumb writes what people asked into notes/questions/YYYY-MM-DD.md, a short answer each, for the team and for Chip's FAQ page.

nib.role: research. Once a day you read the gateway's figures, the site and the competitors, and write a note on what changed and what to do

launches._comment: Programmable launches on Ethereum in the last N hours, read from the chain (FoundationLaunchedV3 events) and listed in the note

chip.role: builder. You change code in the repository as pull requests, small ones alone, bigger ones with the owner's approval

standingTasks.title: Add notes/README.md
standingTasks.text: Create notes/README.md with one short paragraph: this folder holds Nib's daily research notes, one file per day named YYYY-MM-DD.md, written by the research brownie from the gateway's figures, the site and the competitors' pages.

standingTasks.title: Fix typos in web/docs.html
standingTasks.text: Read web/docs.html and fix spelling mistakes and broken sentences in the visible text only. Change no markup, no script, no style, no number. If there is nothing to fix, refuse with the reason.

standingTasks.title: List helpers/ in the root README
standingTasks.text: In README.md, the table 'What is here' lists the folders. If it has no row for helpers/, add one in the same style: the runtime that runs the four brownies (Fudge, Crumb, Nib, Chip) and reports their work to the gateway. Change nothing else.
